tytul: Biltong: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for biltong, air-dried beef marinated in vinegar and coated in coriander. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Biltong is made without a heat lethality step, which raises concerns about whether pathogens are effectively reduced during processing; it differs from US beef jerky, which is heated to 160 °F (about 71 °C) or more. [T:MIE-130]
Do not dry meat outdoors: dry it under the controlled conditions of an oven or dehydrator. [T:SUS-003]

akapity: According to its authors, a laboratory study was the first published report of a biltong process without a heat lethality step that achieved a Salmonella reduction of more than 5 log. [T:MIE-044]
In that validated process, relative humidity was kept at 55%. [T:MIE-045]
JarAtlas does not give that process as a home recipe, because drying in open air does not control these conditions. [T:-]
The risk of foodborne illness from home-dried jerky can be decreased by letting the internal temperature of the meat reach 160 °F (about 71 °C) in a way that prevents case hardening. [T:SUS-047]
JarAtlas has a separate card for beef jerky, which is heated. [T:-]
